title: Keyboard, screen-reader and zoom validation of the design components
body:
## Outcome
Every interactive component in `design/system` has been operated keyboard-only and with a screen reader at 100% and 200% zoom, and the findings are recorded, so that the accessibility claims in the handoff stop being "designed in" and become observed.

## Why now
The original handoff left interaction validation pending. #20 and #32 now provide automated real Tab/Shift+Tab, computed names/roles and structural evidence with intended fonts; this does not establish screen-reader announcements, actual browser zoom or user comprehension. The synthetic persona pack has T13/T14 tasks and UX7/UX8 profiles; the browser journey and task capabilities must exist before those sessions are claimed.

## Scope
- Operate each component preview keyboard-only: focus order, visible ochre focus ring, no trapped focus; `PrerequisiteMap`'s list equivalent reachable; `ComparisonTable` caption and row headers announced.
- Screen reader pass over `EvidenceLabel`, `StatusNotice` (role=status), `LimitPanel` (role=alert vs status), `WaitingState` (aria-live), `ContextChip` (aria-label with Unknown).
- 200% zoom on the SB3 phone boards and the workspace page.
- Record findings as issues with severity per `research/synthetic-ux/facilitator/evaluator-guide.md`.

## Acceptance
- [ ] A findings record (file under `design/` or issues) covering every component and the seven artboards.
- [ ] HANDOFF wording updated from "pending validation" to the observed result.

## Out of scope
Real assistive-technology users (Stage 4 recruitment) — this is the pre-session pass.

## Delivery coordination — 6 November 2026
Status: Ready
Priority: P1
Iteration: 01 / carry-over — #23
Agent/run: unclaimed

Verifier can claim available keyboard/screen-reader/zoom checks; unavailable assistive technology remains explicitly blocked. #20 automated evidence does not close this issue.

Planning checkpoint: [retrospective and revised plan, PR #35](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/pull/35). Recommendations are not active agent dispatch.

## Deferred founder-journey zoom verification — owner approved 6 November 2026

[Decision and review recommendation](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/pull/39#issuecomment-6682937495). Actual 200% browser zoom is deferred from PR #39's pre-merge acceptance to this issue; it remains unverified, not waived. Reviewed PR head: `e75bcef3d85665e076ed62ed90f9555c0072945d`. Verify the resulting pinned build after merge.

- [ ] Use actual browser zoom at 200%, in light and dark themes; record browser/version, build SHA, zoom setting, viewport and screenshots. CSS resizing/device-scale emulation alone is not evidence.
- [ ] Exercise question submission, context editing including Unknown, answer cards, prerequisite evidence and keyboard/focus access. Record clipping, overlap, horizontal overflow or unreachable controls; fix material failures and retest.
- [ ] Link results to #25 and #26. Until verified, #26's actual-zoom T14 variant remains unverified/blocked; other supported variants may proceed through their own readiness checks.

Accountable coordinator: Nissan; verifier remains unclaimed and requires dispatch. This deferral does not establish screen-reader support or accessibility conformance, and does not close this issue.


## Reconciliation against merged #47–#49 — 8 November 2026
By Claude (`claude-reconcile-20261108`) on Nissan's instruction. Verified on `main` at `0a7d9a6` from a fresh clone ([evidence](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/23#issuecomment-6714202965); builder-run, not independent). Nothing was rebuilt.

Status unchanged: **Ready**; nothing here is closed.

- **Recorded:** scoped actual-200% browser-zoom evidence for the founder journey, from the 7 November follow-up (#48 `followup/t14-light-r3-actor.md` and `dark-primed-check.md`). That covers a fresh keyboard actor doing a light-theme stage/context update at zoom 2 (inner 640×400), and a primed dark-theme check of stage, Unknown jurisdiction and evidence focus. These ran on candidate builds (`8c3eaee8` lineage), not on `main` `0a7d9a6`.
- **Still open here:**
  - Actual 200% zoom on the merged build for every deferred item: question submission, context editing including Unknown, answer cards, "Evidence for step N", and keyboard/focus, in both themes.
  - The screen-reader pass.
  - Component-level keyboard and screen-reader validation beyond #20's automated pass.
  - The HANDOFF wording update.
- **Not here:** T13 source navigation and return (#53).
